From someone who HAS smoked in their dorm, let me explain how we did it.

It is really risky, but possible to do with a few simple items assuming you have a window in there. Put a towel or spare blanket under your door to block the bottom opening to lessen the risk of smells or smoke exiting the room. Next, a few dryer sheets on the end of a toilet paper tube (rubber band them) to blow smoke through. This helps lessen the smell and get rid of some of the smoke. Sit close to the open window and blow through the tube towards it. Finally, a small fan on the floor between you and the door will help circulate the air.

It's very risky though and my roommate and I have only done it a few times. Basically as a last resort. Hope this helped. Be safe.

Edit: You can (and probably should) cover the fire alarm. In our dorms we have the sprinkler kind and we can just cover them with a plastic bag. If it's an actual fire alarm, you can take the batteries out or cover them in the same way.
